items.question: What should I do if generation fails?
items.answer: Check that your network connection is stable. Some models may queue during peak hours, so please try again later. If failures persist, submit via the feedback form and we'll investigate as soon as possible.

items.question: What audio formats are supported?
items.answer: Currently MP3 and WAV export are supported. Song covers support JPG and PNG.

items.question: How do I delete a work?
items.answer: Go to the song/album detail page and click the delete button. Once deleted, the work cannot be recovered, so please proceed with caution.

items.question: How long does it take to generate a song?
items.answer: Depending on song length and current queue status, it usually takes 2-5 minutes. Complex arrangements may take longer, so please be patient.

items.question: Who owns the copyright of generated music?
items.answer: You own the copyright to songs generated using Kiyo. Please comply with local laws and regulations and do not use them for illegal purposes.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: Send an email to wangyiyang.kk@gmail.com, or submit an issue via the feedback form at the bottom of the page.

hero.description: Kiyo connects inspiration, arrangement, vocals, and mixing on one timeline — every step keeps the creator in charge.

features.heading: An AI workflow rebuilt for creators
features.description: Not just generation — collaboration. Make AI a bandmate, not a button.

multiModel.title: Multi-model collaboration
multiModel.description: Top music and language models hand off work along one timeline — inspiration, melody, vocals, and mixing each play their part while you conduct.

controllable.title: A controllable process
controllable.description: Not a one-click black box. Lyrics, key, genre, vocals, rhythm, and pauses are all exposed — go SUNO-loose or producer-tight, your call.

endToEnd.title: Spark to finished track
endToEnd.description: One workflow: drafts, collaborative edits, version history, cover and lyric management, export and release. No more juggling ten tools.

aiCover.title: AI Cover
aiCover.description: Transform any song in one click — pop to jazz, rock to folk. Give your music infinite possibilities.

howItWorks.heading: Four steps from spark to release
howItWorks.description: Every step keeps the creator driving — never dragged along by the pipeline.

describe.title: Describe the spark
describe.description: A line of lyrics, an image, a mood. Kiyo turns it into genre, emotion, and section structure.

generate.title: Co-generate
generate.description: Multiple models draft in parallel — verse, chorus, and bridge variants side by side. Pick one and Kiyo carries on.

refine.title: Refine and voice
refine.description: Adjust tempo, modulate keys, swap timbres, layer AI vocals — male, female, articulation style, all directable.

release.title: Mix and release
release.description: One-click mastering, export lossless or streaming-ready — spark to live track in minutes.

showcase.heading: Sample tracks crafted with Kiyo
showcase.description: From Synthwave to Cinematic, Lofi to Future Funk — genre is just the starting line.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Kiyo collects, uses, and protects your information

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: Kiyo ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our AI music creation platform.
intro.p2: By using our service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.p1: We collect the following types of information:

items.email: Account information (email address, password) when you register
items.content: User-generated content (lyrics, songs, albums) you create
items.usage: Usage data (how you interact with our platform, features used)

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.p1: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

items.service: Providing, maintaining, and improving our services
items.ai: Processing content through AI models (Minimax) to generate music

storage.title: Data Storage and Security
storage.p1: Your data is stored securely using Supabase (our backend infrastructure) with industry-standard encryption.
storage.p2: Audio files and user content are stored in secure object storage with regular backups.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.p1: We use third-party services that may have access to your data:

items.minimax: Minimax - AI model provider for music generation

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.p1: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items.access: Right to access your personal data
items.deletion: Right to request deletion of your data

rights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at:

security.title: Data Security
security.p1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "last updated" date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.p1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Terms and conditions for using Kiyo

intro.title: Agreement to Terms
intro.p1: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Kiyo, an AI-powered music creation platform operated by Kiyo ("we," "us," or "our").
intro.p2: By accessing or using our service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you disagree with any part of the terms, you may not access the service.

service.title: Description of Service
service.p1: Kiyo provides an AI-powered platform for music creation, allowing users to generate, edit, and manage music tracks using artificial intelligence models.
service.p2: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the service at any time.

account.title: User Accounts
account.p1: To access certain features, you must create an account. You agree to:

items.register: Provide accurate and complete registration information
items.accurate: Keep your account information up to date
items.security: Maintain the security of your account credentials
items.age: Be at least 16 years old to create an account

content.title: User Content and Intellectual Property
content.p1: You retain ownership of the content you create using Kiyo. By uploading or creating content, you grant us a license to use, store, and process it to provide our services.
content.p2: AI-generated music using our platform can be used for personal and commercial purposes, subject to these Terms.

items.illegal: Use the service for any illegal purpose
items.infringe: Infringe on the intellectual property rights of others
items.harmful: Upload content that is harmful, offensive, or violates others' rights

changes.title: Modifications to Terms
changes.p1: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will provide notice of significant changes by posting the updated Terms on this page.

termination.title: Termination
termination.p1: We may terminate or suspend your access to the service immediately, without prior notice, for any reason, including breach of these Terms.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.p1: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EITHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED.
disclaimer.p2: We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free.
